name: China (1912–1928)
description: Five equal horizontal stripes of red, yellow, blue, white and black — the Five Races Under One Union flag.
history: The five-coloured flag of the Republic of China (1912–1928) represented the Han, Manchus, Mongols, Hui and Tibetans; it was retained by the Beiyang government until the Northern Expedition and was later revived by Japanese-sponsored regimes.
